Eligibility of Tenderer : 1. The minimum number of years of general experience of the Tenderer in the construction works as Prime Contractor or
Subcontractor or Management Contractor shall be 05 (Five)years.
2. A satisfactory completion of similar works (Supply, Installation, Testing & Commissioning of at least 1500 KVA SUB-STATION) of
at least Tk 296 (Two hundred ninety six) Lac in a single contract over a period of 5 (Five) years shall be required in any
government, semi-government or autonomous body.
3. The required average annual construction turnover shall be greater than Tk 12 (twelve) Crore over the last best three (3) years
in the last five (5) years
4. The minimum amount of liquid assets or working capital or credit facilities of the Tenderer shall be Tk 6.0 (Six) crore.
5. The tenderer should have updated trade license, TIN and VAT certificate and incorporation certificate.
6. 5. The tenderer should have updated A-B-C Electric license with supervisory license.
7. The tenderer should have minimum one work done certificate with E-gp ID should be submitted in last 5 years.
8. others qualification criteria as stated in TDS.
